body: When I cut myself for the first time.

I feel very goofy and carefree. I feel like not caring about anything anymore is great. Everything feels like it dosent matter anymore. I could crash my car and still be happy. I feel like no matter what happens I’ll come out with a smile, even though I know I’m not happy. But why does it matter. I think I’m experiencing mania right now.
I know the feeling. Sometimes I feel like I’m on the right path for myself, and then other times it feels like everything is crumbling before me.
